digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer discovery
propositions: Clients running rebar CLI without a checkout encounter dead internal cross-references in packaged guides (consumer-relative paths like review-policy.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md)
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home and is only discoverable via rebar verify-commit-ticket --help
Dangling references in packaged guides must be repointed to either rebar explain <topic> for sibling guides or canonical https://github.com/navapbc/rebar hosted URLs
A link-resolution guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, only https://, intra-doc anchors, or rebar explain references
The commit-trailer format must be packaged as a third author guide and registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES for offline CLI and MCP discovery
